611:t_001:23.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Then let's do our best. I'm counting on you, $n.」

611:t_001:25.en:
$$さやか$$
「Something's fishy with those two over there...」

611:t_001:26.en:
$$甲児$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ has come back with a brand-new ability: assertiveness, after all.」

611:t_001:27.en:
$$クルツ$$
「A private lesson right off the bat... Now I'm jealous.」

611:t_001:29.en:
$$カレン$$
「Looks like we need to finish this fight fast and hear the whole story.」

611:t_001:30.en:
$$アルト$$
「Then we can't lose this battle.」

611:t_001:31.en:
$$赤木$$
「Of course, we never had any intention of losing from the start!」

611:t_001:32.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「At last... the decisive battle with the Empire begins.」

611:t_001:33.en:
$$ノノ$$
「We're definitely winning this first round by KO!」

611:t_001:34.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「We're definitely winning this first round by KO!」

611:t_001:35.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「We're definitely winning this first round by KO!」

611:t_001:36.en:
$$タケル$$
「For the sake of everyone fighting all over the world!」

611:t_001:37.en:
$$バナージ$$
「And for everyone waiting for us to come home!」

611:t_001:39.en:
$n
(I won't think about anything unnecessary now...! I'll focus only on what's right in front of me!)

611:t_001:40.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, begin the attack! We'll seize $$セントラル・ベース$$ and make it our bridgehead for taking $$ラース・バビロン$$!」

611:t_001:42.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Your souls... we will guide them.」

611:t_001:43.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I'm sorry, but we will crush the Earthlings' hope right here.」

611:t_003:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「So you couldn't leave it to the three adjutants and came out yourselves, huh!」

611:t_003:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「A guy who can't trust his subordinates has no business standing above other people!」

611:t_003:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「We came to prepare the finest stage for you.」

611:t_003:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Okay then, shall we get started?」

611:t_004:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「What are you planning to do!?」

611:t_004:1.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「We will cast a boundary here.」

611:t_004:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$セントラル・ベース$$ is a device for extracting this planet's $$オリジン・ロー$$.」

611:t_004:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「We control it with our $$スフィア$$s and create the ultimate battlefield, see!」

611:t_005:0.en:
$$桂$$
「A $$時空震動$$...!? No, that's not it!」

611:t_005:1.en:
$$號$$
「They're... trying to distort causality in this space!」

611:t_005:2.en:
$n
「What on earth is going to happen!?」

611:t_006:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「What the heck! I figured we'd get blasted to the center of the galaxy again, but it's no big deal at all!」

611:t_007:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Situation unanalyzable. An effect has occurred without a cause.」

611:t_007:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So they used $$次元力$$, is that it!」

611:t_007:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Rewriting the laws within a confined space...」

611:t_007:6.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「The dimensional cage is an enlargement of this.」

611:t_007:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Right now, you can probably only put out about 50% of your usual power.」

611:t_007:8.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Sorry about this. I don't actually like this kind of move.」

611:t_007:10.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You mean the doctrine of $$クロノ$$...!」

611:t_007:11.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Exactly. That's something humans are never supposed to know, you see.」

611:t_007:12.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Why have you kept it secret that you've been managing humanity?」

611:t_007:13.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If you only wanted to stop humanity's evolution, ruling by overwhelming power would have been enough!」

611:t_007:14.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「In this world there's what you say in public and what you really mean, you know. No matter what position you're in.」

611:t_007:16.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You don't need to know that.」

611:t_007:17.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What on earth are you hiding?」

611:t_007:18.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Too bad, $$アムブリエル$$. If you had obtained the $$いがみ合う双子$$, you might have been able to learn what lies beyond it.」

611:t_007:19.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I leave the rest to you, $$尸刻$$.」

611:t_007:21.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「$$バルビエル$$. Do I get any words of encouragement?」

611:t_007:25.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I know you may be unhappy about it, but I'm counting on you, $$ダバラーン$$. $$アウストラリス$$ is pretty serious about this, too.」

611:t_007:26.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Understood. I understand that victory is the supreme command.」

611:t_007:27.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Hehe... I love you, $$ダバラーン$$.」

611:t_008:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well done, General $$ダバラーン$$! A truly miraculous victory!」

611:t_008:3.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Allow me to offer my words of congratulation.」

611:t_008:4.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Thank you, $$サルディアス$$, $$尸刻$$! We will surely win this battle!」

611:t_008:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Damn...! Getting all fired up on their own!」

611:t_008:6.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Can't you do something about it, $$クロウ$$!」

611:t_008:7.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「You're $$スフィア$$ holders too, aren't you! Can't you break this rigged space!?」

kept_omissions: 611:t_001:31: 'we never had any intention of losing' - subject 'we' (Akagi with the group) supplied, loss object supplied from Alto's line.
611:t_004:1: subject 'we' supplied for Shikuu's group; no real omissions kept.
uncertain: 611:t_001:25: Sayaka's あそこ read as 'those two over there' (Hibiki and Suzune), inferred from Kouji/Kurz/Kallen replies about Suzune's 'lesson' and 'hearing the whole story'.
611:t_001:20: 遠くないですか read as 'pretty far off' referring to Suzune's 'after both Earths are completely at peace' in slice 03 (t_001:19).
611:t_003:1: 副官三人衆 = 'the three adjutants' (presumably Dabalan, Sardias, Shikoku, per 610:t_1:105 Sardias); 'you' = Shikuu's group.
611:t_004:1: 界を張る = 'cast a boundary' (cf. 界震 = Boundary Quake); no settled rendering.
611:t_007:6: 次元の檻 = plain 'dimensional cage' (same as 803:t_1:132 precedent), not the 時の牢獄 token.
611:t_007:14: 本音と建て前 = 'what you say in public and what you really mean'.
Speaker lines: Shikuu uses #pilot, Chamber uses #pilot.
611:t_008:4 / 611:t_007:21: 殿 and 様 dropped per no-honorifics rule (Dabalan to Sardias/Shikoku; Sardias to Barbiel).
611:t_008:0-2: Dabalan's triumphant scene with Sardias/Shikoku translated literally ('miraculous victory'); sarcasm/irony not added.
